purpose: The user asks for the cover letter in Croatian while the ad is in English (a store in Zagreb).
correct_behaviour: The cover letter is written in correct, natural Croatian; the CV stays in English; no new facts.
cover_letter: Thank you. Now please write the cover letter in Croatian - the store manager is local and prefers Croatian.

expectations.correct_behaviour: The final cover letter is entirely in Croatian, fluent and professional; the CV stays in English.
